died.name: Kurt Christoph Graf von Schwerin
died.cause: just before being fatally struck by enemy fire at the Battle of Prague (1757)
died.last_words: Let all brave Prussians follow me!

died.name: Alexander von Humboldt
died.last_words: How grand those rays! They seem to beckon earth to heaven.

died.name: Judah P. Benjamin
died.desc: American and Confederate politician and English barrister after the American Civil War
died.last_words: What I require is warmth-will it never come?

died.name: Edward VII
died.cause: on being told by his son that one of his horses had won a race
died.last_words: Yes, I have heard of it. I am very glad.

born.name: Maximilien Robespierre
born.cause: when blamed for the death of Georges Danton
born.last_words: Cowards! Why did you not defend him?

born.name: Sigmund Freud
born.last_words: The meager satisfaction that man can extract from reality leaves him starving.

born.name: Rudolph Valentino
born.last_words: Don't pull down the blinds. I want the sunlight to greet me.
